_comment: Default commits resolved when no explicit branch/hash is supplied. Update these after verifying a build passes with a newer commit. The susfs pins are keyed per KSU variant because each flavor tracks the susfs sync at a different point: tiann/KernelSU main matches v2.3.0 (eba2a88a), while KernelSU-Next dev needs the v2.2.0-era patch that WildKernels' fix sets still target.
